name: convin-sense
description:
Bring your Convin Sense data into ChatGPT. Ask about your campaigns, leads and AI agents in plain language: how campaigns performed over a period, why leads are or aren't interested, what was said on a call, how your agents are set up, and how much calling capacity and usage your organization has.

Access is read-only and limited to your own organization. Your role's permissions and your organization's PII masking settings apply to every answer. Requires an existing Convin Sense account with ChatGPT access enabled by your administrator.

interface.longDescription:
Bring your Convin Sense data into ChatGPT. Ask about your campaigns, leads and AI agents in plain language: how campaigns performed over a period, why leads are or aren't interested, what was said on a call, how your agents are set up, and how much calling capacity and usage your organization has.

Access is read-only and limited to your own organization. Your role's permissions and your organization's PII masking settings apply to every answer. Requires an existing Convin Sense account with ChatGPT access enabled by your administrator.
defaultPrompt: How did my campaigns perform last week?
Why are leads in my latest campaign not interested?
Which of my AI agents are live and on which campaigns?

positive.prompt: How did my campaigns perform between 20 October and 2 November 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports leads attempted and connected, calls, talk time, interested and goal-achieved counts for the Loan Renewal campaign in that period.

positive.prompt: Why are leads in the Loan Renewal campaign not interested?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives lead counts per interest level and summarises the recorded reasons for not-interested leads, such as interest rate too high, took a loan elsewhere or no need.

positive.prompt: Show me the latest calls for the lead with phone number +919000000103.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the lead Rohan Gupta and lists recent calls with their status, duration and summary; can show the transcript on request.

positive.prompt: Which AI agents do I have and which campaigns use them?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the agent Riya – Loan Renewal with its language, channel and status, and shows that it is attached to the Loan Renewal campaign.

positive.prompt: Why did calls in the Loan Renewal campaign fail to connect between 20 October and 2 November 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the connect rate, the main failure reasons (no answer, busy and similar), results per caller id and the best times to call.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Bengaluru today?
Write a cold email template for a SaaS product.
Start a new campaign and call all my leads now.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only access to campaign analytics, leads, call history, AI agents, usage and capacity.
